words.definition: to leave a job or stop doing something
words.example: She decided to quit her job to start her own business.
words.exampleTranslation: 她決定辭職去創業。
words.note: 不規則動詞三態同形：quit - quit - quit

words.definition: the power or right to give orders and make decisions
words.example: Only senior management has the authority to approve this budget.
words.exampleTranslation: 只有高階管理層有權力核准這筆預算。
words.note: 常用複數形 authorities 指政府機關或當局

words.definition: a contagious illness causing fever, aches, and respiratory symptoms (short for influenza)
words.example: Several employees called in sick with the flu this week.
words.exampleTranslation: 這週有幾位員工因為流感請病假。
words.note: flu 是 influenza 的簡稱，口語中較常用

words.definition: the person in charge of a ship, aircraft, or team
words.example: The captain announced that the flight would be delayed by an hour.
words.exampleTranslation: 機長廣播說這班航班將延誤一小時。
words.note: 常見於 team captain（隊長）這個搭配用法

words.definition: the act of setting up equipment or software so it is ready to use
words.example: The installation of the new software will take place overnight.
words.exampleTranslation: 新軟體的安裝作業將在夜間進行。
words.note: 動詞形：install (v.) 安裝，例如 Please install the update before restarting your computer。

words.definition: a person who teaches skills to others, especially in a professional setting
words.example: A trainer was brought in to teach the new sales process.
words.exampleTranslation: 公司請了一位培訓人員來教授新的銷售流程。
words.note: 相關詞：trainee (n.) 受訓者，與 trainer（訓練師）相對

words.definition: the state of being able to be used or obtained
words.example: Please check your availability for a meeting next Tuesday.
words.exampleTranslation: 請確認你下週二是否有空檔可以開會。
words.note: 形容詞形：available (adj.) 可獲得的；有空的，例如 Is the manager available this afternoon？

words.definition: an item bought at a lower price than usual, or an agreement between parties
words.example: Shoppers lined up early to get the best bargains at the sale.
words.exampleTranslation: 購物者一早就排隊，想搶到特賣會最好的特價品。
words.note: 常用片語 more than you bargained for（意料之外、超出預期）

words.definition: given free of charge, especially as a courtesy
words.example: Guests receive a complimentary breakfast with every room booking.
words.exampleTranslation: 每間房的訂房都附贈免費早餐。
words.note: 易與 complementary（互補的）混淆，兩字拼法相近但意思不同

words.definition: a long walk, especially in natural surroundings, or a sudden increase
words.example: The team went on a hike as part of the company retreat.
words.exampleTranslation: 團隊在公司靜修活動中安排了一場健行。
words.note: 常見於 price hike（價格上漲）這個搭配用法

words.definition: twelve o'clock at night
words.example: The online sale ends at midnight tonight.
words.exampleTranslation: 這場線上特賣將於今晚午夜結束。
words.note: 常用片語 burn the midnight oil（開夜車；熬夜工作）

words.definition: the rate at which work is efficiently completed
words.example: The new software boosted the team's productivity significantly.
words.exampleTranslation: 新軟體大幅提升了團隊的生產力。
words.note: 形容詞形：productive (adj.) 有生產力的，例如 a productive meeting（一場有成效的會議）

words.definition: characterized by a lot of rain
words.example: The outdoor launch event was moved indoors due to rainy weather.
words.exampleTranslation: 因為多雨的天氣，戶外發表會改到室內舉行。
words.note: 常用片語 save for a rainy day（未雨綢繆；存錢以備不時之需）

words.definition: to move to a new place, especially for work
words.example: The department will relocate to the new building next month.
words.exampleTranslation: 這個部門下個月將搬遷到新大樓。
words.note: 相關詞：relocation (n.) 搬遷，例如 The company offered a relocation package to new hires。

words.definition: a person who is being trained for a job or skill
words.example: Each trainee is paired with an experienced mentor.
words.exampleTranslation: 每位受訓者都會配對一位經驗豐富的導師。
words.note: 動詞形：train (v.) 訓練，例如 New employees are trained for two weeks before starting。

words.definition: an instance of buying or selling something, or an exchange
words.example: All transactions over a certain amount require manager approval.
words.exampleTranslation: 所有超過一定金額的交易都需要經理核准。
words.note: 常見於 business transaction（商業交易）這個搭配用法

words.definition: not feeling or showing happiness; dissatisfied
words.example: The customer was unhappy with the delayed delivery.
words.exampleTranslation: 這位顧客對延遲到貨感到不滿意。
words.note: 反義詞：happy（快樂的）前面加上否定字首 un- 就變成 unhappy

words.definition: to check that something is true or accurate
words.example: Please verify your account details before submitting the form.
words.exampleTranslation: 送出表格前請先核實你的帳戶資料。
words.note: 相關詞：verification (n.) 驗證；查核，例如 The bank requires identity verification for large transfers。

words.definition: a road vehicle powered by an engine; a car
words.example: The automobile industry has seen a shift toward electric vehicles.
words.exampleTranslation: 汽車產業已經出現轉向電動車的趨勢。
words.note: 較正式的說法，日常對話中通常直接說 car

words.definition: a person or company that delivers messages or packages
words.example: A courier will pick up the package from the office at noon.
words.exampleTranslation: 快遞員會在中午到辦公室取件。
words.note: 常見於 courier service（快遞服務）這個複合詞
